close_reason: Already documented: email.rs:463-464 says 'Parse and validate each header: property before touching the backend, so we can return invalidArguments without issuing any storage queries'. Lines 473-475 explain the collect-all-errors approach.
description: email.rs accumulates all header: property parse and form-validation errors before issuing any backend calls. This is correct: it lets the handler return invalidArguments without touching storage even if multiple properties are bad. A future contributor might move validation to be inline per-property or lazy, which would cause partial backend queries before the error surfaces. The collect::<Result<Vec<_>, _>>() pattern on lines 395-404 is the intentional mechanism — do not split it into a per-property early-return that bypasses the remaining validation.
title: Validate all header: properties before backend calls in Email/get
